Name: UnofficialSkeleton's Anthro mod
Author: UnofficialSkeleton
Description:
[center]﻿[/center][center][size=5][b]UNOFFICIALSKELETON'S ANTHRO REPLACER[/b][/size]﻿[/center][center]

☽–☆–––––––––––––––––––☁︎––––––––––––––––––☆–☾
[b][size=3]INTRODUCTION: [/size][/b]

Have you ever installed the portrait mod by the talented [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/gaveliere.616423/]Gaveliere[/url]﻿ (Later finished by sion9000 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083?tab=description]mod here[/url]﻿)
but thought to yourself:"Oh gee, this looks really great, but why can't I be an anthro character myself?".
Well, today is your lucky day.

This mod isn't overly-complicated, it's a simple xnb replacer that turns your
playable character to a very generic anthro, but at least now you won't
feel too out of place. 

﻿☽–☆–––––––––––––––––––☁︎––––––––––––––––––☆–☾
[size=3][b]HOW TO DOWNLOAD:

[/b][/size]It's not difficult at all, all you have to do is to go to the content folder > Characters > Farmer and drag and
drop the downloaded files. Make sure you make a backup file! I wouldn't want to see your game
corrupt because I did a silly mistake. :(

☽–☆–––––––––––––––––––☁︎––––––––––––––––––☆–☾
